title: Spatial Relics
description: Adds a collection of spatial relics that complement vanilla mechanics and enhance the survival experience.
body:
A collection of advanced utility artifacts designed to complement vanilla mechanics and elevate the survival experience.

### **Melee Artifacts** * **Iron Blade** ![iron blade recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f7d963c4c9710ea52a10170cb506cb51ce0134c.png) A versatile weapon with longer reach and a wider sweep area than a sword. Its attack speed sits perfectly between an axe and a sword. Right-clicking allows you to guard, mitigating 25% of incoming damage. * **Shadow Drawing Blade** ![shadow drawing blade recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e864e0253edf6f4b80010c931074ef1ce72c10a.png) ![iai](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8513cfa7138fbd18a6e6edc0b3e3c78164f488cc.png) The pinnacle of craftsmanship, created by combining an Iron Blade with a Netherite Ingot and an **Echo Shard Smithing Template**. It matches Netherite-tier stats and enables the **Iai (Quick-draw)** technique. * **Iai Strike:** Hold Shift + Right-click to charge. Once the darkness fog fully constricts, release while aiming at an enemy to dash forward 4 blocks and strike a target instantly. * **Power:** Strong enough to one-shot a Piglin Brute. If a kill is achieved, aggression will not spread to nearby mobs of the same type. * **Utility:** Slows nearby enemies during charging. Iai can be used for mobility or to boost Elytra flight. Movement speed during charging scales with the **Soul Speed** enchantment. * **Defense:** Guards 50% of damage, deflects projectiles, and negates status effects from physical attacks. **Knockback** enchantment compatibility allows successful melee guards to repel enemies based on the enchantment level without dealing damage. * **Echo Shard Smithing Template** ![echoshard smithing template recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e93165049a7b079eceaaccd33207a805718db3d7.png) Crafted using a Netherite Upgrade Template and an Echo Shard. Required to forge the Shadow Drawing Blade. ### **Defense & Utility** * **Echoing Shield** ![echoing shield recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a5b823d7332b5ad3a536306a4b097eb43053e4c.png) A reactive shield capable of absorbing damage. While guarding, Left-click to release stored energy as a frontal shockwave (up to 50 damage). * **Lodestone Anchor** ![lodestone anchor recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/101a804b3b3aa6530f4a59d904fafd32ee18c3b8.png) Sync this device by Right-clicking a Lodestone. Once synchronized, it points toward its target. * **Lifesaving Recall:** If you take fatal damage while holding a synced Anchor, you are instantly teleported to the Lodestone's coordinates with 1 HP. The Anchor shatters upon use. * **Constraint:** Works only within the same dimension. * *Compatible with the "[Charm of Undying](https://modrinth.com/mod/charm-of-undying)" mod.* ### **Combat & Ranged Weaponry** * **Composite Bow** ![composite bow recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a4b46165cbc0d85f17896aa3a76461936713cd5.png) Features double the muzzle velocity and precision of a standard bow, resulting in twice the damage and range. However, it demands mastery: charge time is 30% longer, and each shot consumes 4 hunger points. * **Durability:** High durability; repairable with Copper Ingots. * **Utility:** Pressing 'B' while holding or charging the bow triggers **Arrow Cycling**, rotating through different arrow types available in the inventory. * **Special:** If enchanted with Infinity, there is a 50% chance to not consume Transposition or Spectral arrows. * **Transposition Arrow** ![transposition arrow recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97bb8b796ab06dc937e72855b340f7cba7405033.png) Swaps the positions of the shooter and the target upon impact. Deals zero damage, allowing for tactical repositioning without provoking neutral mobs. One Ender Pearl yields 8 arrows. * **Spectral Arrow (Enhanced)** When fired while a **Lodestone Anchor** is in your inventory, any loot and XP from the slain mob are instantly teleported to the player's location.
